title: truss retro state, version 1
description: <truss dir>/retro/state.json: where the end-of-run retro is, step by step. Only retro/cli.ts writes it (the state command); the PM and the local web UI read it. The steps run in the order extract, judges, triage, fixGoal, applied. See adr/0012-self-improving-retro.md, Decision 8. ui/contract/state.schema.json copies this shape as the state's retro key.

v.description: File format version. A reader treats a file with any other v as absent.

updatedAt.description: When retro/cli.ts last wrote the file: an RFC 3339 UTC date-time ending in Z.

extract.description: retro/cli.ts extract wrote <truss dir>/retro/extract.json for the whole session.

judges.description: The truss:retro-judge agents ran and retro/cli.ts findings saved what they returned.

triage.description: A fresh checking engineer sorted the findings into fix now, defer or drop.

fixGoal.description: The fix-now findings went into plan.json as a goal through amend (adr/0010-mid-run-intake.md). skipped when triage kept none.

applied.description: The fix goal's crews merged (done), or at least one failed QC and was not merged (failed). skipped when there is no fix goal.

status.description: pending until the step starts; running while it works; then done, failed or skipped.

at.description: When retro/cli.ts last set this step's status, an RFC 3339 UTC date-time; null while pending.

detail.description: One line for the client, such as 3 findings kept, 1 dropped; else null. No transcript text.
